answer_1.quote: Text summarization, owing to its practical application, has received increasing interest from the research community.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use an average of the three ROUGE scores i.e. ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L F1 scores.

answer_4.quote: we invited three volunteers who are professional English speakers to examine the summaries based on two criteria: informativeness and coherence.
answer_4.guideline: based on two criteria: informativeness and coherence
